tools.name: create_site
tools.description: Create a new site owned by the caller. Site name must be lowercase letters/digits/hyphens, 1-64 chars. Returns { site } only. Read server instructions and call get_deployment_rules before building a zip or deploying.

tools.name: list_sites
tools.description: List all sites owned by the authenticated caller, including deploy URLs, custom domain status, and bandwidth usage (with warning at 80% and shutdown message when the custom domain is suspended).

tools.name: get_deployment_rules
tools.description: REQUIRED before deploy: returns platform deploy rules + a site-scoped checklist, example URLs for this site_id, and a short-lived deploy_ack_token. Call after create_site or list_sites. Pass the token to create_deploy_upload and commit_deploy_upload.

tools.name: create_deploy_upload
tools.description: Start a staging deploy: request presigned PUT URL for the zip. Use promote_staging_to_prod to go live on production. Requires deploy_ack_token from get_deployment_rules when MCP_ENFORCE_DEPLOY_ACK is on. Pass the same token to commit_deploy_upload. Returns upload_id; PUT the zip then commit_deploy_u

tools.name: commit_deploy_upload
tools.description: Finalize deploy after PUT using upload_id. Pass the same deploy_ack_token from get_deployment_rules for this site as on create_deploy_upload when MCP_ENFORCE_DEPLOY_ACK is on.

tools.name: list_deployments
tools.description: List deployments for a site, optionally filtered to one environment. Excludes pruned (deleted) versions. Only the current deployment plus 5 previous versions per environment are retained.

tools.name: promote_staging_to_prod
tools.description: Promote the current staging deployment to production (the only way to go live on prod). Copies the active staging artifact into a new prod version. Requires an active current staging deployment; does not accept a zip.

tools.name: rollback_deployment
tools.description: Promote a previous deployment back to current for its environment.

tools.name: download_deployment
tools.description: Download a deployment version as a zip (presigned GET URL, expires in ~15 minutes). Use list_deployments to find deployment_id. Omits cleanUrls materialized copies when possible and includes static-hosting.json for editing and redeploying to staging.

tools.name: connect_custom_domain
tools.description: Attach an externally owned domain to a site's live prod deployment. Returns ACM DNS validation CNAMEs (apex + www). Requires active prod deploy and an active domain subscription (subscribe in console first).

tools.name: get_custom_domain_status
tools.description: Poll custom domain setup progress; triggers one processing tick. Returns steps and dns_records (cert validation + routing).

tools.name: disconnect_custom_domain
tools.description: Remove custom domain connection for a site (best-effort CloudFront disable + ACM delete).

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "list_deployments" appears informational but accepts parameters (environment) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_sites, get_deployment_rules, download_deployment · Private data: get_deployment_rules, create_deploy_upload · Public sink: create_deploy_upload, commit_deploy_upload · Destructive: disconnect_custom_domain.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_sites, get_deployment_rules, download_deployment · Private data: get_deployment_rules, create_deploy_upload · Public sink: create_deploy_upload, commit_deploy_upload · Destructive: disconnect_custom_domain

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
